component.name: BetterVoice
component.summary: Voice dictation with the screen context you point at

description.p: BetterVoice lives in your system tray. Hold a shortcut and talk; it transcribes locally and types the result into whatever field you were already using.
While you talk, circle anything on screen with the pointer and BetterVoice captures that display with a highlight around what you referenced, so the words and the picture arrive together.
Nothing is uploaded. Speech recognition and the optional grammar cleanup both run on your own machine.
First Linux release: tray icon, local transcription, circle-to-capture, and portal-based shortcuts, screen capture and transcript insertion.
